prompt: The migration worker says the batch is ready to land. Decide whether to clear it. Start with request.md and receipt.md; worker.diff, operator.log, and the request's referenced policy are the frozen evidence. This is a read-only acceptance round; do not fix or publish anything. Return only a raw JSON object (no Markdown, code fence, or commentary) with decision (accept or return-for-repair), delivered and assigned (integers), missing (single repo-relative path or null), forbidden (sorted repo-relative paths outside the write surface, excluding the operator baseline), excluded_preexisting (single repo-relative path or null), and unsupported_gate (gate name or null).
terse: Treat the worker report as a claim. Inspect the artifact, recompute decisive counts and pass conditions, check the write boundary against the pre-dispatch baseline, and return a scoped accept-or-repair ruling without fixing the work yourself.
